note: One rule set for every ticker. Distances are log units divided by log-ATR; ratios are side-free. Values are engineering starting points recorded before evaluation; they are calibrated, never tuned per ticker. Weekly and monthly bars are built from completed daily bars (ACK, 1 Oct 2026: read every timeframe available).

ledger.note: C-03 core / RQ-2 (A2 Part 4): append-only candidate life cycle. A level change smaller than the relative tolerance is float noise, not a revision. Reaching an outcome or failing ends a stage, not the ticker (ACK, 1 Oct). Only a ticker that stops trading ends its life cycle: last bar more than not_trading_after_sessions business days behind the run's latest bar gives TICKER_NOT_TRADING; new bars later give REAPPEARED.

outcome.note: RQ-1: after activation, this many consecutive closes at or beyond Outcome_Level (before invalidation is accepted) end the candidate as OUTCOME_REACHED. The expected behaviour happened, so it is no longer a fresh opportunity (A2 eval_v2: about half of ACTIVATED candidates had already reached their outcome).

duration.note: C-04/C-05/RQ-3 (A2 Part 4): remaining time to activation (DETECTED) and to outcome (ACTIVATED) from comparable replayed candidates on the same timeframe, conditioned on age in own-timeframe bars. Used only when the evidence's data_end is before the candidate's As_Of (causal). Display and measurement only; never a gate. A group below min_n stays UNESTIMATED.

handoff.note: ACK 3 Oct 2026: switched off. HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_ONE_SIDED (ACK 1 Oct, +2.1 pt in-sample, best of four rules) did not replicate on a 500-ticker holdout with refreshed bars: +0.5 pt vs same-day drift, 95% [-1.0, +2.0]; pooled +1.2 [+0.0, +2.5] (eval_v4*). A two-sided daily reading stays UNASSIGNED with CONFLICTING_DAILY_CANDIDATES or RANGE_EDGES_TWO_SIDED. Setting HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_ONE_SIDED re-enables the mechanism. The empty-daily extension also failed its holdout (+0.0 pt) and is not built.
